fields.user_note: text safe to show to end users; the only note field that may reach an API response
fields.internal_note: developer-only context; never returned by the API
fields.manage_booking_url: https URL of the manage-trip page on the airline's own site, or null if not verified
fields.phone: customer-service number in E.164 form, or null if not verified
fields.verified_on: date phone and URL were both confirmed by direct page read; null otherwise
fields.sources: official page(s) the values were taken from
fields.note: why a field is null, when it is
fields.verification: weakest status of the shown fields (manage_booking_url, phone): verified (page read directly on the official domain) | official_source_unconfirmed (seen on the official domain only via search result, page not read) | unknown (nothing shown). lookup() returns an entry when it has a URL and phone and status is verified or official_source_unconfirmed.
fields.other_channels: official-domain chat URL, text line, or X handle; recorded for a future messaging agent, nothing consumes it yet
fields.status_url: official status/help page when no phone exists
